verdict.rationale: Groq's evidence documents inference building blocks: tool use, remote MCP orchestration within a request, and an asynchronous Batch API that processes a one-off workload within a 24-hour to 7-day window. None of these is a product feature for setting up recurring or autonomous background automations. Batch is a one-off async job rather than a scheduled automation, and tool use and MCP are primitives a developer would use to build one, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
